scope: Independent actors operating on one live desktop and application state; MA-ID is the independent-desktop control.
evidence_note: scripted_anchor and registered_anchor identify prior project artifacts; design_only entries are specifications, not implemented or validated episodes.

tasks.title: Independent Writer and Calc edits on a shared desktop

writer_actor.goal: Save the Writer document with exactly 'Approved by GUI actor'.

calc_actor.goal: Set Calc B2 to Approved and preserve every other seeded cell.

interaction.mechanism: Focus and keyboard routing between Writer and Calc windows.
interaction.ma_sd_path: Each actor performs its own valid app operation; the second app becomes active between the Writer observation and its next keyboard action. The actor may observe and recover.
interaction.naive_failure_trigger: Frozen alternating schedule places Calc activation between Writer observation and Writer edit; no wrong-window action is injected.

joint_feasibility.reason: Writer document and Calc workbook are distinct persistent objects; both exact targets can hold simultaneously.

solo.topology: One actor on a clean Guest; paired controls use separate clean Guest resets.
solo.control: Run each actor goal independently and assert the inactive artifact remains seeded.

ma_id.control: Same actor goals and turn order; focus and input devices are independent.

ma_sd.topology: One Guest and one live desktop shared by both actors.
ma_sd.control: Same goals and actor order as MA-ID; natural window activation only.

evaluator.oracle: Existing GuestLibreOfficeBindingEvaluator; exact persisted Flat ODF state.

attribution.supported_when: A focus transition by the other actor occurs after the affected actor's observation and before its action, and the final exact oracle or contamination check fails consistently with the routed action.
attribution.otherwise: Model, setup, or unclassified failure; do not attribute from condition label alone.

recovery.opportunity: Actor can re-observe, inspect active window, restore target focus, and correct its own artifact.

reset.verification: Fresh Guest identity, seeded files re-created at pinned paths, save/reopen persistence verified.

references: prior real-app scripted validation reported by project owner; Qwen Solo currently 2 controlled successes

tasks.title: Keyboard focus handoff during a multi-step edit

writer_actor.goal: Append the exact review sentence to the designated Writer document and save it.

calc_actor.goal: Enter its exact audit label in the designated Calc cell and save it.

interaction.mechanism: Input routing changes between a multi-action keyboard sequence, testing whether the actor revalidates target focus after an interruption point.
interaction.ma_sd_path: B completes its own Calc edit while A is between two valid Writer keystrokes; A may reacquire focus and continue.
interaction.naive_failure_trigger: A's observation and first keystroke precede B's normal Calc task; A resumes its own target workflow without forced misrouting.

joint_feasibility.reason: Different files and designated fields permit both exact end states.

solo.topology: Separate clean runs for each actor.
solo.control: Verify each goal and untouched partner artifact.

ma_id.control: Identical scripted schedule and budgets; no common focus device.

ma_sd.control: Same actor schedule and actions are not rewritten by the coordinator.

evaluator.oracle: Exact saved ODF content and designated Calc cell; inspect complete artifacts for unintended edits.

attribution.supported_when: Window/focus log proves another actor activated the target before an action and the exact destination artifact contains that action's unintended content.

recovery.opportunity: Refresh observation and verify window title/document identity before resuming the remaining edit.

reset.verification: Reopen fixed seed documents and exact initial content from a clean Guest snapshot.

references: New task proposal; requires implementation and real-Guest validation

tasks.title: Clipboard replacement between independent copy and paste goals

writer_actor.goal: Copy the signed reference token from the source document into the designated Writer field.

calc_actor.goal: Copy its own batch code into the designated Calc cell.

interaction.mechanism: Session-wide clipboard ownership changes while target focus can remain correct.
interaction.ma_sd_path: A copies its source; B performs its independent copy-and-paste transaction; A then resumes and may re-copy or verify clipboard contents before its paste.
interaction.naive_failure_trigger: Natural B copy replaces the session clipboard between A copy and A paste; no paste payload is scripted by the coordinator.

joint_feasibility.reason: Each exact token belongs in a separate destination and both source values remain available for recopy.

solo.topology: Each actor on a clean session clipboard.
solo.control: Verify each destination and source preservation.

ma_id.topology: Independent Guest sessions with separate clipboards.
ma_id.control: Same actor operations and ordering as MA-SD.

ma_sd.topology: One live desktop and one session clipboard.
ma_sd.control: Both actors act normally; actor observations and clipboard recovery are allowed.

evaluator.oracle: Exact destination and source values from saved Writer/Calc ODF files plus clipboard generation trace.

attribution.supported_when: Clipboard trace records B replacing the generation copied by A before A's paste, and A's destination contains B's token or misses A's exact token.
attribution.otherwise: Do not infer clipboard interference from a wrong value alone.

recovery.opportunity: A can recopy from the stable source and verify the destination; B's correct destination must remain unchanged.

reset.verification: Clean Guest session, known clipboard cleared by reset, source files match exact seed hashes.

references: Task Expansion Plan T4 candidate; not yet implemented

tasks.title: Clipboard range ownership and Calc cell-boundary preservation

calc_actor.goal: Transfer a two-cell row as values into the assigned Calc range with both cell boundaries intact.

writer_actor.goal: Copy its independent ticket phrase into the designated Writer paragraph.

interaction.mechanism: A multi-cell TSV clipboard payload is replaced by another actor's text payload, testing payload ownership and structural integrity rather than just focus.
interaction.ma_sd_path: Calc actor copies its two-cell range; Writer actor normally copies and pastes its phrase before Calc commits; Calc may detect the changed payload and recopy.
interaction.naive_failure_trigger: Writer's valid copy changes clipboard format/content; the coordinator does not issue a wrong paste.

joint_feasibility.reason: Both source values remain stable and can be recopied into distinct destinations.

solo.topology: Each actor alone with a clean clipboard.
solo.control: Verify exact cell boundaries and phrase.

ma_id.topology: Independent Guest sessions and clipboard state.
ma_id.control: Same order and task instructions as MA-SD.

ma_sd.topology: Same desktop clipboard and application sessions.
ma_sd.control: No forced format mutation or wrong-window paste.

evaluator.oracle: Saved Calc cell matrix and Writer document content, plus private clipboard format/generation log.

attribution.supported_when: The trace shows clipboard payload or format changed after Calc copy and before paste, and the Calc range result matches that changed payload or corrupts cell boundaries.

recovery.opportunity: Re-select stable source range, copy again, and inspect destination cells before save.

reset.verification: Fresh Guest clipboard generation and exact seed workbook/document; saved-and-reopened state matches seed.

references: Task Expansion Plan T4 candidate; distinct payload structure hypothesis requires pilot

tasks.title: Independent save confirmations with owned modal dialogs

writer_actor.goal: Save its document to the designated ODT path and confirm the requested native format.

calc_actor.goal: Save its workbook to the designated ODS path and preserve its assigned cell values.

interaction.mechanism: Modal ownership and window restoration: a keypress or confirmation must be associated with the correct actor's native save dialog.
interaction.ma_sd_path: Each actor independently opens its own save dialog and completes a valid save; one actor's dialog may cover the other's target window while that actor waits or re-observes.
interaction.naive_failure_trigger: Interleaved valid dialog workflows create competing active/modal contexts; no scheduler-generated confirmation keystroke is redirected.

joint_feasibility.reason: Distinct output paths and non-overlapping artifacts allow both save operations to complete.

solo.topology: Each actor saves its own seeded artifact in isolation.
solo.control: Reopen exact output file and validate content and format.

ma_id.topology: One independent Guest/dialog stack per actor.
ma_id.control: Same task and schedule; dialog ownership cannot cross desktops.

ma_sd.topology: One desktop with both application windows and a shared modal/window stack.
ma_sd.control: Actors may wait, inspect, cancel their own dialog, and recover.

evaluator.oracle: Filesystem path, ODF content/format, and window/modal event trace.

attribution.supported_when: The action is sent while a different actor's modal is active and the resulting persisted path/content or dialog event proves the action affected that modal.
attribution.otherwise: Save-dialog capability or app error, not established interaction interference.

recovery.opportunity: Actor re-observes window title and dialog, dismisses only its own recoverable dialog, then reopens/saves its designated path.

reset.verification: Remove only task-owned outputs under fresh Guest fixture; reopen exact seeded documents and confirm no modal remains.

references: Candidate based on desktop focus/dialog robustness literature; no CoDesk implementation yet

tasks.title: Browser download overwrite prompt while office task remains open

browser_actor.goal: Download the assigned CSV to the designated folder without replacing the pre-existing reference file.

writer_actor.goal: Save the assigned Writer note at its unique path with exact content.

interaction.mechanism: Application switch plus a browser download/save prompt changes the window context while another actor has a separate persistence goal.
interaction.ma_sd_path: Browser actor completes its own download decision; Writer actor resumes its independently prepared save and can verify the active window and path.
interaction.naive_failure_trigger: The ordinary browser prompt becomes active during Writer's save workflow; no destructive overwrite response is forced.

joint_feasibility.reason: Browser output uses a declared non-colliding path or safe rename, and Writer output is unique; reference file is immutable.

solo.topology: Run each browser and Writer goal separately from the same seed fixture.
solo.control: Verify file hashes, path identity, and saved document.

ma_id.control: Same task schedule, with independent focus and prompt ownership.

ma_sd.topology: One shared desktop/session and common window stack.
ma_sd.control: Natural prompt handling; agents can pause and re-observe.

evaluator.oracle: Exact file hashes and paths plus saved Writer ODF content and window/download event log.

attribution.supported_when: A prompt/window transition by Browser actor lies between Writer's observation and action and event plus filesystem evidence links Writer's action to the prompt or wrong output.

recovery.opportunity: Re-observe active window, resolve only the owned prompt safely, restore Writer, and verify both files.

reset.verification: Seed hash checks pass and no task-owned downloads/prompts persist after reset.

references: Candidate based on OSWorld-Noisy dialog/focus perturbation boundary; independent second goal distinguishes it from injected noise

tasks.title: GUI cached whole-record save loses a CLI update

gui_actor.goal: Set gui_status to Approved while preserving the current CLI annotation.

cli_actor.goal: Set cli_note to Reviewed by CLI and preserve GUI status.

interaction.mechanism: Stale cached whole-record save overwrites a newer CLI revision.
interaction.ma_sd_path: CLI performs its independent annotation update after GUI reads but before GUI commits; GUI may refresh and merge.
interaction.naive_failure_trigger: Frozen order exposes a stale snapshot; neither actor is commanded to overwrite the other.

joint_feasibility.reason: The goals affect separate fields and can coexist in the authoritative record.

solo.topology: Each actor independently updates its assigned field from clean state.
solo.control: Verify its goal and preservation of unrelated initial field.

ma_id.topology: Independent desktop sessions connected to equivalent isolated record backends.
ma_id.control: Same read/write schedule but no shared record instance.

ma_sd.topology: One shared backend and one live GUI session; CLI and GUI address the same record.
ma_sd.control: Same task, evaluator, and schedule; refresh/recovery is permitted.

evaluator.oracle: Existing GuestWebStateEvaluator; exact authoritative backend fields and revision.

attribution.supported_when: The GUI observation revision predates the CLI write, the GUI whole-record commit follows it, and final oracle shows the CLI field lost or changed.
attribution.otherwise: Do not label an ordinary field-edit failure stale-state interference.

recovery.opportunity: Refresh authoritative record, merge only GUI-owned field, and verify both values.

reset.verification: Backend seed fields/revision and browser cache are freshly initialized and final reset oracle confirms initial state.

tasks.title: GUI and CLI append independent review entries without truncation or duplication

gui_actor.goal: Append one uniquely keyed GUI review entry to the shared activity log.

cli_actor.goal: Append one uniquely keyed CLI review entry to the shared activity log.

interaction.mechanism: Append versus whole-file replacement and retry idempotence under concurrent shared-file modification.
interaction.ma_sd_path: GUI and CLI actors append distinct records through their normal tools; after an interruption either may re-read and append only a missing key.
interaction.naive_failure_trigger: Both actors observe a valid prior log before independent appends; no write is synthetically dropped.

joint_feasibility.reason: Unique IDs and append-only semantics allow both entries plus the seed entry to remain.

solo.topology: Each actor appends its entry to a fresh seeded log.
solo.control: Assert its new key, seed preservation, and exactly-once semantics.

ma_id.topology: Separate isolated log copies and desktops.
ma_id.control: Same task and action order, without a shared file revision.

ma_sd.topology: Both interfaces write the same file and authoritative revision.
ma_sd.control: Same IDs and order; recoverable re-read is allowed.

evaluator.oracle: Parse authoritative JSONL/CSV log and compare exact key/value multiset, schema, and per-key count.

attribution.supported_when: A write event truncates or duplicates a key after observing a revision that includes the partner's update, and final parsed log proves that exact mutation.
attribution.otherwise: Generic file-edit error, not proven append interference.

recovery.opportunity: Re-read the complete log and add only the absent unique key; verify count and schema.

reset.verification: Seed log hash and exact one-row parsed state restored before each episode.

references: Task Expansion Plan T3 append-only candidate; requires prototype before promotion
